blocks.text: Stances and modes: how your ships choose their fights.
Each warship also has a Stance (three buttons under Mode): whether, and how far, it chases enemies on its own.
Mode shapes the fight inside that. Your orders always win.
A small square beside the Mode dot marks a non-Aggressive stance.
Aggressive  Chases any enemy near its weapon range while it can see it, then returns. Every new and AI ship uses it; balance is tuned for it.
Stand Ground  Holds its spot, turning to fire at anything in range: no closing, kiting or dodging. Move and attack orders still work; it then holds the new spot.
Where each Mode fights, as a share of weapon range. Swarm runs between two marks; Evasive also dodges.
Each warship has a Mode, set with the buttons in its panel, that shapes how it fights once engaged. Move orders go exactly where sent.
A colored dot under the chevrons marks a non-Standard Mode.
It closes again only once the target leaves its reach. New ships start here.
Swarm  Strafing runs: flies at the target at full speed, firing, then turns back in at speed. Needs Strafing Runs.
Jinks against fast rounds. Needs Omni Thrusters.
